mapper.sql: SELECT b.material_id, m.name AS material_name, m.code, m.spec, c.name AS category_name, u.name AS unit_name, b.quantity, m.safety_stock, b.last_movement_at FROM stock_balance b JOIN material m ON m.id = b.material_id JOIN unit u ON u.id = m.unit_id JOIN material_category c ON c.id = m.category_id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.status <> 'archived'

sql.if: AND b.quantity > 0 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM stock_movement sm WHERE sm.material_id = b.material_id AND sm.type = 'OUT' AND sm.reversed = false AND sm.occurred_at > now() - interval '90 days' )

mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM stock_balance b JOIN material m ON m.id = b.material_id JOIN unit u ON u.id = m.unit_id JOIN material_category c ON c.id = m.category_id WHERE m.deleted_at IS NULL AND m.status <> 'archived'
